newsitem.title: ITALY: Piedmont board members named - Italian newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Piedmont board members named - Italian newspaper.

text.p: Piedmont International, a Luxemburg-registered investment vehicle set up to acquire the PC interests of Italian hi-tech group Olivetti, currently has three members on its board and two shareholders, an Italian newspaper reported on Thursday.

Turin daily La Stampa said Piedmont had been constituted in on December 30 and had three board members, U.S. lawyer Edward Gottesman, Italian industrialist Gianmario Rossignolo and a London-based investment banker, Herbert Lee Oakes.
Piedmont is to acquire Olivetti's ailing PC division in a deal worth 250 to 300 billion lire and Rossignolo, who is chairman of Electrolux's Zanussi, has agreed to run the new venture.

La Stampa said the company register in the Grand Duchy showed that Piedmont was capitalised at $100,000. Its shareholders were Gottesman's Centenary Corporation of Wilminton, Delaware, with 9,900 shares. Lee Oakes held the balance of 100 shares.
